mapper.select: SELECT id, map_key, name, icon_url, description, event_name, forageable_id, created_at, updated_at FROM dynamic_map_resources WHERE map_key = #{mapKey} ORDER BY name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dynamic_map_resources (map_key, name, icon_url, description, event_name, forageable_id) VALUES (#{mapKey}, #{name}, #{iconUrl}, #{description}, #{eventName}, #{forageableId})
mapper.update: UPDATE dynamic_map_resources SET name=#{name}, icon_url=#{iconUrl}, description=#{description}, event_name=#{eventName} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE map_pins SET name=#{after.name}, icon_url=#{after.iconUrl}, description=#{after.description} WHERE map_key=#{before.mapKey} AND category='dynamic_resource' AND name=#{before.name}
UPDATE dynamic_map_resources SET event_name=#{newName} WHERE map_key=#{mapKey} AND event_name=#{oldName}
